summary: Kat's runs gain the read-only process 'account_reconciliation' (monthly GL 2300 reconciliation and exceptions, reviewed on Today, nothing posts) and it is switched on for the five associations with a 2300 account.

preflight.name: no run uses an unknown process
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM accounting_runs WHERE process NOT IN ('recognition', 'interest', 'bank_reconciliation', 'cutoff_adjustment', 'reclassification', 'journal_entry')

preflight.name: no account_reconciliation automation yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_accounting_automation WHERE process = 'account_reconciliation'

preflight.name: the five associations each have a 2300 account

expected_changes: accounting_runs and community_accounting_automation: process may be 'account_reconciliation'.
Five community_accounting_automation rows (Waterview, Lakes of Pine Forest, Canyon Gate, Quail Ridge, Still Creek): account_reconciliation enabled, auto_post false.
No journal entry, ledger row or balance changes.

verify.name: the run process constraint allows account_reconciliation
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'accounting_runs_process_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%account_reconciliation%'

verify.name: five enabled, never auto-posting
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_accounting_automation WHERE process = 'account_reconciliation' AND enabled AND NOT auto_post
